rca:flags.text: 1 of 8 upcasts found in the profiler data do not match a profile in the official index.
Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied.

The .cnv holds the downcast only (17919 scans, 16337 kept after removing ship-heave reversals). Bottle (.btl) averages are taken at upcast bottle closures, so CTD-vs-Autosal uses upcast data while profiler-vs-CTD uses the downcast.
Niskin 11 (SA-62, ~121 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle -0.1941 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.035 PSU/m.
Niskin 11 (SA-62, ~121 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle -0.1979 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.035 PSU/m.
Autosal workbook header date is 2025-04-19 but the cast is on 2024-08-09; looks like a template leftover (not changed).
